source: The owner's words typed in the same working session as reviews/OWNER_BOOK_CLOSER_TO_CONCEPT_2026-11-25.json, in the desktop app, after the session showed him the book set closer to the concept (pull request 107). This record is written by the same session: it saw the words below typed.
theWords: Закончи сначала все недоделки интерфейса. Когда выполним работу интерфейса - книги на 100%, я проверю и продолжим работа над остальными 53 книгами.
Бой не должен быть мелким. Сделай его на весь экран.
whatHeAsksFor: Every loose end of the book interface finished first, so that the interface as a book is whole; he checks it then.
The fight large: the battlefield takes the whole screen.
The ornaments, seals and other materials of the fifty-three books that have none wait until he has checked the finished interface.
whatTheSessionFound: In his own window (about 766 px wide) the fight's map was some 510 px wide beside a column of cards; on a tablet held wide the map kept about half of the sheet. The session's survey of every page at that width also found pages and cards the book had not reached: the result of an action and what the table asks on dark glass, dialogs that open outside the book (a hero's sheet, the guide, the account, the Chronicle), lists of a few options still shown as the browser's own lists, the Encounter page's cards.

authorized: The fight as the whole sheet from a tablet up: the map as large as its squares go, the order of turns a narrow column or a row, the cards over the map's edge or behind the board's tools; a pull request stacked on the book set closer to the concept (pull request 107).

After it, in pull requests stacked one on another: every card, slip and dialog on the book's paper; the remaining choices as pictures and faces; lists, dates, numbers and scrolling in the book's hand; the shelf, the way in, the table's screen, the Chronicle; the workshop and a hero's builder; wording and small things.
The checks, the journeys and the layout audit for each; a real screen shown early.
notAuthorized: Drawing the materials of the fifty-three books that have none (after he has checked the interface).
Opening the two built-in adventures' written books (they wait for his reading, ADR 0074 §2.8).

standingOwnerRulesThisWorkKeeps: 2026-11-20: no rails — «DnD — это про свободу выбора и действий».
2026-11-21: sections full screen with a way to close, everything at hand, the least scrolling; every main DM task has a visible entry named with his own word.
2026-11-21: «Читать всё самому» — every phrase a model wrote is read by the owner before it reaches a table.
2026-11-23: each book has its own style from its campaign's art; book materials by Codex CLI.
2026-11-25: the book is the whole screen; everything is in the book or in a bookmark; no raw web controls; show a real screen early.
unchangedBoundaries: The World Engine alone changes the world; rules and legality stay the server's.
Knowledge isolation: a player's client and the table's screen receive only their own projections.
No AI at the table; no paid provider call beyond the pictures Codex CLI makes for the book materials.
Nothing is merged or deployed by the session without the owner's word.
